preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of characters '0' and '1'.
The length of the input string is between 1 and 200,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the count of awesome substrings, where an awesome substring is defined as a substring with at least one '1' and length divisible by the number of '1's in it.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1) if (count_ones := sum(1 for c in s[i:j] if c == '1')) >= 1 and (j - i) % count_ones == 0)
postconditions.description: The output equals the number of substrings s[i:j] (0-based, inclusive) where the substring contains at least one '1' and its length (j - i) is divisible by the number of '1's in it.
